shortDescription: Module for setup of VirtualService Avi RESTful Object

options.name: active_standby_se_tag
options.description: This configuration only applies if the virtualservice is in legacy active standby ha mode and load distribution among active standby is enabled. This field is used to tag the virtualservice so that virtualservices with the same tag will share the same active serviceengine. Virtualservices with different tags will have different active serviceengines. If one of the serviceengine's in the serviceenginegroup fails, all virtualservices will end up using the same active serviceengine. Redistribution

options.name: allow_invalid_client_cert
options.description: Process request even if invalid client certificate is presented. Datascript apis need to be used for processing of such requests. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: analytics_policy
options.description: Determines analytics settings for the application.

options.name: analytics_profile_ref
options.description: Specifies settings related to analytics. It is a reference to an object of type analyticsprofile.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: apic_contract_graph
options.description: The name of the contract/graph associated with the virtual service. Should be in the <contract name> <graph name> format. This is applicable only for service integration mode with cisco apic controller. Field introduced in 17.2.12,18.1.2.

options.name: application_profile_ref
options.description: Enable application layer specific features for the virtual service. It is a reference to an object of type applicationprofile.

options.name: auto_allocate_floating_ip
options.description: Auto-allocate floating/elastic ip from the cloud infrastructure. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: auto_allocate_ip
options.description: Auto-allocate vip from the provided subnet. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Availability-zone to place the virtual service. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: avi_allocated_fip
options.description: (internal-use) fip allocated by avi in the cloud infrastructure. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: avi_allocated_vip
options.description: (internal-use) vip allocated by avi in the cloud infrastructure. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: azure_availability_set
options.description: (internal-use)applicable for azure only. Azure availability set to which this vs is associated. Internally set by the cloud connector. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.2.

options.name: bulk_sync_kvcache
options.description: (this is a beta feature). Sync key-value cache to the new ses when vs is scaled out. For ex  ssl sessions are stored using vs's key-value cache. When the vs is scaled out, the ssl session information is synced to the new se, allowing existing ssl sessions to be reused on the new se. Field introduced in 17.2.7, 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: client_auth
options.description: Http authentication configuration for protected resources.

options.name: close_client_conn_on_config_update
options.displayName: Close Client Conn On Config Update
options.description: Close client connection on vs config update. Field introduced in 17.2.4. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: cloud_config_cksum
options.description: Checksum of cloud configuration for vs. Internally set by cloud connector.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type cloud.

options.name: cloud_type
options.description: Enum options - cloud_none, cloud_vcenter, cloud_openstack, cloud_aws, cloud_vca, cloud_apic, cloud_mesos, cloud_linuxserver, cloud_docker_ucp, cloud_rancher, cloud_oshift_k8s, cloud_azure, cloud_gcp. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as CLOUD_NONE.

options.name: connections_rate_limit
options.description: Rate limit the incoming connections to this virtual service.

options.name: content_rewrite
options.description: Profile used to match and rewrite strings in request and/or response body.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name.

options.name: delay_fairness
options.description: Select the algorithm for qos fairness. This determines how multiple virtual services sharing the same service engines will prioritize traffic over a congested network. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: discovered_network_ref
options.description: (internal-use) discovered networks providing reachability for client facing virtual service ip. This field is deprecated. It is a reference to an object of type network. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: discovered_networks
options.description: (internal-use) discovered networks providing reachability for client facing virtual service ip. This field is used internally by avi, not editable by the user. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: discovered_subnet
options.description: (internal-use) discovered subnets providing reachability for client facing virtual service ip. This field is deprecated. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: dns_info
options.description: Service discovery specific data including fully qualified domain name, type and time-to-live of the dns record. Note that only one of fqdn and dns_info setting is allowed.

options.name: dns_policies
options.description: Dns policies applied on the dns traffic of the virtual service. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: east_west_placement
options.description: Force placement on all se's in service group (mesos mode only). Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_autogw
options.description: Response traffic to clients will be sent back to the source mac address of the connection, rather than statically sent to a default gateway. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_rhi
options.description: Enable route health injection using the bgp config in the vrf context.

options.name: enable_rhi_snat
options.description: Enable route health injection for source nat'ted floating ip address using the bgp config in the vrf context.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable or disable the virtual service. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: error_page_profile_ref
options.description: Error page profile to be used for this virtualservice.this profile is used to send the custom error page to the client generated by the proxy. It is a reference to an object of type errorpageprofile. Field introduced in 17.2.4.

options.name: floating_ip
options.description: Floating ip to associate with this virtual service. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: floating_subnet_uuid
options.description: If auto_allocate_floating_ip is true and more than one floating-ip subnets exist, then the subnet for the floating ip address allocation. This field is applicable only if the virtualservice belongs to an openstack or aws cloud. In openstack or aws cloud it is required when auto_allocate_floating_ip is selected. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: flow_dist
options.description: Criteria for flow distribution among ses. Enum options - LOAD_AWARE, CONSISTENT_HASH_SOURCE_IP_ADDRESS, CONSISTENT_HASH_SOURCE_IP_ADDRESS_AND_PORT. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as LOAD_AWARE.

options.name: flow_label_type
options.description: Criteria for flow labelling. Enum options - NO_LABEL, APPLICATION_LABEL, SERVICE_LABEL. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as NO_LABEL.

options.name: fqdn
options.description: Dns resolvable, fully qualified domain name of the virtualservice. Only one of 'fqdn' and 'dns_info' configuration is allowed.

options.name: host_name_xlate
options.description: Translate the host name sent to the servers to this value. Translate the host name sent from servers back to the value used by the client.

options.name: http_policies
options.description: Http policies applied on the data traffic of the virtual service.

options.name: ign_pool_net_reach
options.description: Ignore pool servers network reachability constraints for virtual service placement. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Ip address of the virtual service. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: ipam_network_subnet
options.description: Subnet and/or network for allocating virtualservice ip by ipam provider module. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: l4_policies
options.description: L4 policies applied to the data traffic of the virtual service. Field introduced in 17.2.7.

options.name: limit_doser
options.description: Limit potential dos attackers who exceed max_cps_per_client significantly to a fraction of max_cps_per_client for a while. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: max_cps_per_client
options.description: Maximum connections per second per client ip. Allowed values are 10-1000. Special values are 0- 'unlimited'. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: microservice_ref
options.description: Microservice representing the virtual service. It is a reference to an object of type microservice.

options.name: min_pools_up
options.description: Minimum number of up pools to mark vs up. Field introduced in 18.2.1, 17.2.12.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the virtual service.

options.name: network_profile_ref
options.description: Determines network settings such as protocol, tcp or udp, and related options for the protocol. It is a reference to an object of type networkprofile.

options.name: network_ref
options.description: Manually override the network on which the virtual service is placed. It is a reference to an object of type network. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: network_security_policy_ref
options.description: Network security policies for the virtual service. It is a reference to an object of type networksecuritypolicy.

options.name: nsx_securitygroup
options.description: A list of nsx service groups representing the clients which can access the virtual ip of the virtual service. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: performance_limits
options.description: Optional settings that determine performance limits like max connections or bandwidth etc.

options.name: pool_group_ref
options.description: The pool group is an object that contains pools. It is a reference to an object of type poolgroup.

options.name: pool_ref
options.description: The pool is an object that contains destination servers and related attributes such as load-balancing and persistence. It is a reference to an object of type pool.

options.name: port_uuid
options.description: (internal-use) network port assigned to the virtual service ip address. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: remove_listening_port_on_vs_down
options.displayName: Remove Listening Port On Vs Down
options.description: Remove listening port if virtualservice is down. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: requests_rate_limit
options.description: Rate limit the incoming requests to this virtual service.

options.name: saml_sp_config
options.description: Application-specific saml config. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: scaleout_ecmp
options.description: Disable re-distribution of flows across service engines for a virtual service. Enable if the network itself performs flow hashing with ecmp in environments such as gcp. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: se_group_ref
options.description: The service engine group to use for this virtual service. Moving to a new se group is disruptive to existing connections for this vs. It is a reference to an object of type serviceenginegroup.

options.name: security_policy_ref
options.description: Security policy applied on the traffic of the virtual service. This policy is used to perform security actions such as distributed denial of service (ddos) attack mitigation, etc. It is a reference to an object of type securitypolicy. Field introduced in 18.2.1.

options.name: server_network_profile_ref
options.description: Determines the network settings profile for the server side of tcp proxied connections. Leave blank to use the same settings as the client to vs side of the connection. It is a reference to an object of type networkprofile.

options.name: service_metadata
options.description: Metadata pertaining to the service provided by this virtual service. In openshift/kubernetes environments, egress pod info is stored. Any user input to this field will be overwritten by avi vantage.

options.name: service_pool_select
options.description: Select pool based on destination port.

options.name: services
options.description: List of services defined for this virtual service.

options.name: sideband_profile
options.description: Sideband configuration to be used for this virtualservice.it can be used for sending traffic to sideband vips for external inspection etc.

options.name: snat_ip
options.description: Nat'ted floating source ip address(es) for upstream connection to servers.

options.name: sp_pool_refs
options.description: Gslb pools used to manage site-persistence functionality. Each site-persistence pool contains the virtualservices in all the other sites, that is auto-generated by the gslb manager. This is a read-only field for the user. It is a reference to an object of type pool. Field introduced in 17.2.2.

options.name: ssl_key_and_certificate_refs
options.description: Select or create one or two certificates, ec and/or rsa, that will be presented to ssl/tls terminated connections. It is a reference to an object of type sslkeyandcertificate.

options.name: ssl_profile_ref
options.description: Determines the set of ssl versions and ciphers to accept for ssl/tls terminated connections. It is a reference to an object of type sslprofile.

options.name: ssl_profile_selectors
options.description: Select ssl profile based on client ip address match. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: ssl_sess_cache_avg_size
options.description: Expected number of ssl session cache entries (may be exceeded). Allowed values are 1024-16383. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1024.

options.name: sso_policy
options.description: Client authentication and authorization policy for the virtualservice. Field deprecated in 18.2.3. Field introduced in 18.2.1.

options.name: sso_policy_ref
options.description: The sso policy attached to the virtualservice. It is a reference to an object of type ssopolicy. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: static_dns_records
options.description: List of static dns records applied to this virtual service. These are static entries and no health monitoring is performed against the ip addresses.

options.name: subnet
options.description: Subnet providing reachability for client facing virtual service ip. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: subnet_uuid
options.description: It represents subnet for the virtual service ip address allocation when auto_allocate_ip is true.it is only applicable in openstack or aws cloud. This field is required if auto_allocate_ip is true. Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: topology_policies
options.description: Topology policies applied on the dns traffic of the virtual service based ongslb topology algorithm. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: traffic_clone_profile_ref
options.description: Server network or list of servers for cloning traffic. It is a reference to an object of type trafficcloneprofile. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: traffic_enabled
options.description: Knob to enable the virtual service traffic on its assigned service engines. This setting is effective only when the enabled flag is set to true. Field introduced in 17.2.8. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: type
options.description: Specify if this is a normal virtual service, or if it is the parent or child of an sni-enabled virtual hosted virtual service. Enum options - VS_TYPE_NORMAL, VS_TYPE_VH_PARENT, VS_TYPE_VH_CHILD. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as VS_TYPE_NORMAL.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: use_bridge_ip_as_vip
options.description: Use bridge ip as vip on each host in mesos deployments. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: use_vip_as_snat
options.description: Use the virtual ip as the snat ip for health monitoring and sending traffic to the backend servers instead of the service engine interface ip. The caveat of enabling this option is that the virtualservice cannot be configued in an active-active ha mode. Dns based multi vip solution has to be used for ha & non-disruptive upgrade purposes. Field introduced in 17.1.9,17.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the virtualservice.

options.name: vh_domain_name
options.description: The exact name requested from the client's sni-enabled tls hello domain name field. If this is a match, the parent vs will forward the connection to this child vs.

options.name: vh_parent_vs_uuid
options.description: Specifies the virtual service acting as virtual hosting (sni) parent.

options.name: vip
options.description: List of virtual service ips. While creating a 'shared vs',please use vsvip_ref to point to the shared entities. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: vrf_context_ref
options.description: Virtual routing context that the virtual service is bound to. This is used to provide the isolation of the set of networks the application is attached to. It is a reference to an object of type vrfcontext.

options.name: vs_datascripts
options.description: Datascripts applied on the data traffic of the virtual service.

options.name: vsvip_cloud_config_cksum
options.description: Checksum of cloud configuration for vsvip. Internally set by cloud connector. Field introduced in 17.2.9, 18.1.2.

options.name: vsvip_ref
options.description: Mostly used during the creation of shared vs, this field refers to entities that can be shared across virtual services. It is a reference to an object of type vsvip. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: waf_policy_ref
options.description: Waf policy for the virtual service. It is a reference to an object of type wafpolicy. Field introduced in 17.2.1.

options.name: weight
options.description: The quality of service weight to assign to traffic transmitted from this virtual service. A higher weight will prioritize traffic versus other virtual services sharing the same service engines. Allowed values are 1-128. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.
